mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, code, approve_status, source_code, source_id, so_code, so_id, invalid_status, customer_id, customer_name, approve_user_id, approve_user_name, approve_time, change_reason
mapper.select: select sdncd.id as detailId, sdncd.source_detail_id as sourceDetailId, sdncd.so_detail_id as soDetailId, sdncd.sku_id as skuId, sdncd.sku_no as skuNo, sdncd.product_name as productName, sdncd.change_type as changeType, sd.qty as saleQty, (select COALESCE(sum(a.delivery_qty),0) from so_delivery_notice_detail a where a.source_detail_id = sdnd.source_detail_id and a.is_deleted = false) as allNoticeQty, sdnd.delivery_qty as currentNoticeQty, (select COALESCE(sum(a.picked_qty),0) from picking_detail a where a.source_detail_id = sdnd.id and a.is_deleted = false) as pickedQty, sd.remark from so_delivery_notice_change sdnc inner join so_delivery_notice_change_detail sdncd on sdnc.id = sdncd.main_id inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdnd.id = sdncd.source_detail_id inner join so_detail sd on sd.id = sdncd.so_detail_id where sdnc.is_deleted = false and sdncd.is_deleted = false and sdnd.is_deleted = false and sd.is_deleted = false and sdnc.id = #{id}
